# {{ site.title }} by thechelsuk

> Free web tools, calculators, converters and templates at {{ "/" | absolute_url }}. Most tools run entirely in your browser, with nothing uploaded to a server.

Key facts:

- Free to use, no account or sign-up
- Made in the UK by thechelsuk ({{ site.organization.url }})
- UK-specific calculators cover redundancy pay, FIRE retirement, ISA bridging and drawdown runway
- Some tools are marked "run locally" and are meant to be downloaded and run on your own machine
